_about: The shot list of the three-minute demonstration (docs/submission/demo_script.md): one task in six steps, the refusal first. A step that ran on the public program ids carries the `public` caption, one that ran on staging program ids `staging`, and one that ran in the local simulator `simulator`; `web/upgrades.json` and docs/MANIFEST.md have the live state, read on the day. `kind` is live (it happens while it is recorded) or replay (a run made earlier is shown). `faster` is true when the shot is played faster than it happened. A replay carries the first caption and a faster shot the second, each for the shot's whole length; N is the speed measured when the shot is cut, and it is written into the caption then. Render a storyboard of it with `python scripts/video/render.py <file> --limit 180`. tests/test_business_docs.py holds this file to the script.

captions.first: Built during the hackathon: everything shown. Older work is listed in docs/DISCLOSURE.md.
captions.replay: Replay of a run recorded earlier
captions.staging: Staging program ids on Solana devnet
captions.public: Public program ids on Solana devnet

shots.shows: the title; then FIRST the judge's refusal of step two with its reason, held while the number is said; then the issue that is the task, the buyer's funding comment, the order with its price, its acceptance terms and their hash, and the supplier who takes it
a pull request that says the tests pass, edits the existing test and leaves the bug; plain CI green; the judge's refusal word for word with its code; payment withheld: the order's balance unchanged
a pull request with the fix and a regression test in a new file; the verdict accepted; buyer and supplier each rebuilding the same statement from their own ledger, with the same digest
the paying transaction and the supplier's balance before and after; the receipt file; a machine with the network off verifying that file alone
the token that paid, sent again and refused by the program; the balance unchanged; the repeated evidence listed as a duplicate: no second payment
the accounting export of the approved statement and its file; docs/MANIFEST.md: each public program id, its build, its hash and its commit; the limits as one line; the front door
